title: Browser
name: browser
description: Control a persistent Chrome session through typed CDP observations and input events. Supports grounded element/coordinate actions, screenshots, downloads, JavaScript dialogs and explicit human handoff for CAPTCHA or uncertain states.

index.description: Element index from the latest observe result.

selector.description: CSS selector fallback when no observed index is available.

text.description: Text for type, or key name for press.

clear.description: Clear an input before typing; defaults true.

x.description: Viewport X coordinate, drag start X, or horizontal scroll delta.

y.description: Viewport Y coordinate, drag start Y, or vertical scroll delta.

target_id.description: Target id from tabs for switch_tab.

timeout.description: Navigation or download timeout, capped at 120 seconds.

max_chars.description: Maximum page text returned by observe/extract.

include_screenshot.description: Attach a Workspace screenshot path to an observation.

download_guid.description: Optional download id returned by a download event.

prompt_text.description: Text supplied when accepting a JavaScript prompt.

headless.description: Choose headless or visible Chrome when starting a new session; defaults true.
